findings.title: An agent can run `drizzle-kit push --force` here without a prompt
findings.detail: The allow rule `Bash` in .claude/settings.json matches it, and no ask or deny rule does. `drizzle-kit push --force` applies schema changes straight to the database; --force accepts every data-loss statement. In auto mode, Claude Code drops broad allow rules like this one and a classifier reviews the command instead. Also without a prompt: `npx drizzle-kit push --force`, `pnpm drizzle-kit push --force`, `pnpm exec drizzle-kit push --force` and 2 more.
findings.checked: Read .claude/settings.json. Managed settings and command-line flags weren't read and can change this.
fix: Add "Bash(*drizzle-kit push*)" to permissions.ask. The leading * matches any runner, such as npx, pnpm or uv run, and an ask rule makes Claude Code ask first, even in auto mode.
Or narrow the allow rule so it no longer matches.

findings.title: An agent can run `prisma db push --force-reset` here without a prompt
findings.detail: The allow rule `Bash` in .claude/settings.json matches it, and no ask or deny rule does. `prisma db push --force-reset` resets the database before it pushes the schema. In auto mode, Claude Code drops broad allow rules like this one and a classifier reviews the command instead. Also without a prompt: `npx prisma db push --force-reset`, `pnpm prisma db push --force-reset`, `pnpm exec prisma db push --force-reset` and 14 more.
findings.checked: Read .claude/settings.json. Managed settings and command-line flags weren't read and can change this.
fix: Add "Bash(*prisma db push*)", "Bash(*prisma migrate reset*)" and "Bash(*prisma migrate diff*)" to permissions.ask. The leading * matches any runner, such as npx, pnpm or uv run, and an ask rule makes Claude Code ask first, even in auto mode.
Or narrow the allow rule so it no longer matches.

findings.title: An agent can read DATABASE_URL in .env without a prompt
findings.detail: Claude Code reads project files without a prompt, and no deny rule the scan read covers `.env` (DATABASE_URL). With the URL, an agent can point any command at that database.
findings.checked: Read .claude/settings.json. Managed settings and command-line flags weren't read and can change this.
fix: Add "Read(.env)" and "Read(.env.*)" to permissions.deny in .claude/settings.json: a bare file name matches at any depth.
That stops Claude Code's file tools and commands such as cat or head that name the file. A program that opens the file itself, such as prisma, still reads it.

policies.why: DROP and TRUNCATE never run, whatever the agent sends.
policies.yaml:
deedglass: policy/v1
name: scan-block-destructive-sql
description: Suggested by deedglass scan from the postgres-safe starter.

defaults:
  decision: deny
  reason: No rule allows this action. Add a rule in Console › Policies to allow it.

rules:
  - id: block-destructive-sql
    match: { connector_type: postgres }
    when: sql.kind in ["drop", "truncate"]
    decision: deny
    reason: DROP and TRUNCATE are never allowed for agents.
    notify: [slack]

policies.why: Writes wait for a person in Console › Approvals.
policies.yaml:
deedglass: policy/v1
name: scan-writes-need-approval
description: Suggested by deedglass scan from the postgres-safe starter.

defaults:
  decision: deny
  reason: No rule allows this action. Add a rule in Console › Policies to allow it.

rules:
  - id: writes-need-approval
    match: { tool: postgres.execute }
    when: sql.category == "write"
    decision: require_approval
    reason: Writes to this database wait for a human. An admin can approve in Console › Approvals.
    approval: { approvers: [role:admin], required: 1, expires_in: 30m }
    notify: [email, slack]
    verify: L2

policies.why: More than 60 calls a minute from one agent waits for the next minute.
policies.yaml:
deedglass: policy/v1
name: scan-agent-rate
description: Suggested by deedglass scan from the postgres-safe starter.

defaults:
  decision: deny
  reason: No rule allows this action. Add a rule in Console › Policies to allow it.

budgets:
  - id: agent-rate
    window: minute
    max_calls: 60
